answer: The ocean counter is kept in reef and cipher publishes each reset. An copycat thus has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 43 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 43 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1919 identities would post 3179 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
